title: הקוצים שנדבקו לכלב — ונהפכו לסקוץ׳ שבנעליים שלכם
summary: Velcro: George de Mestral's 1941 Alpine hunting trip, burdock burrs under the microscope (hundreds of hooks catching loops), seed hitchhiking (epizoochory; Israel's Xanthium strumarium on Nahal Oren near Atlit), Lyon cotton strips, nylon hardened under infrared and loops cut into hooks, ~10 years of mechanisation, Swiss patent 1951/1955, velours+crochet, NASA/Apollo; peel vs shear (all hooks share load sideways ~0.84 kg/cm², peel depends on width only ~0.75 kg/cm), with a 10% creep safety-factor challenge.
reviewer_verdict: PASS (2 rounds) — nits left: prose still ~1.6× the 1,100-word target (tag says כ־30 דקות; younger kids may need 35–40 min); labels ~17 CSS px on 360px phones; step-5 figure is a top view only; kit lint/check missing from the repo so local stand-ins were used; Arto and the AI grader not exercised on file://; the review copy doesn't declare the sample capability, so Arto falls back there (template)
